newsitem.title: USA: Praxair ups production of semiconductor gases.
newsitem.headline: Praxair ups production of semiconductor gases.

text.p: Praxair Inc, which produces industrial gases, said on Monday that it had increased production of two gases essential to silicon chip manufacturing and added 16 new semiconductor process gases to its portfolio.

"By expanding our capacity, product line and distribution capability, including additional warehouses, Praxair is better positioned to serve the demanding needs of the microelectronics industry," said Ted Trumpp, general manager of the company's electronics business segment.
In a statement, Praxair said it had increased production of phosphine by 100 percent and arsine by 50 percent at an Arizona facility.
